items.heading: "Environmental Science" Is Not One
items.text: "Environmental science" is not one job. It splits into six tracks that share a subject in college and almost nothing else once you look at who hires, what the entry route is, and what the role pays. Two of them, EIA consulting and corporate ESG, sit in the private sector and currently lead on pay.

items.heading: Every Major Infrastructure, Mining,
items.text: Every major infrastructure, mining, or industrial project in India legally needs an Environmental Impact Assessment before it can get a clearance from the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) or a State Environment Impact Assessment Authority (SEIAA). That legal requirement is what funds this entire private-consulting track.
